description: This file defines the DataSeriesValues class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the Chart namespace. It manages properties and behaviors related to data series in charts, such as data types, data sources, formatting, visual markers, colors, line styles, and trend lines.

classes.name: DataSeriesValues
classes.description: Represents a data series in a chart, handling data types, data source formulas, formatting, markers, colors, trend lines, and other visual properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of DataSeriesValues with specified data type, data source, format code, point count, data values, marker, fill color, and point size.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the series (String or Number).

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the series, validating input against allowed types.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Returns the formula or reference used as the data source.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source formula or reference.

methods.name: getPointMarker
methods.description: Returns the point marker style.

methods.name: setPointMarker
methods.description: Sets the point marker style.

methods.name: getMarkerFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color object for the marker.

methods.name: getMarkerBorderColor
methods.description: Returns the border color object for the marker.

methods.name: getPointSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the data points.

methods.name: setPointSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the data points.

methods.name: getFormatCode
methods.description: Returns the format code.

methods.name: setFormatCode
methods.description: Sets the format code.

methods.name: getPointCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data points.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the fill color object or array.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color as a string or array of strings.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color, accepting ChartColor objects, strings, or array of either.

methods.name: validateColor
methods.description: Validates that a hex color string is valid.

methods.name: getLineWidth
methods.description: Returns the line width style property.

methods.name: setLineWidth
methods.description: Sets the line width style property.

methods.name: isMultiLevelSeries
methods.description: Determines if the data series is multi-level.

methods.name: multiLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum level count in a multi-level data series.

methods.name: getDataValues
methods.description: Returns the data values array.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Returns the first data value or full array if multiple.

methods.name: setDataValues
methods.description: Sets the data values, flattening nested arrays.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates data values from the data source formula, optionally flattening.

methods.name: getScatterLines
methods.description: Returns whether scatter lines are enabled.

methods.name: setScatterLines
methods.description: Sets whether scatter lines are enabled.

methods.name: getBubble3D
methods.description: Returns whether 3D bubble mode is enabled.

methods.name: setBubble3D
methods.description: Sets 3D bubble mode.

methods.name: getSmoothLine
methods.description: Returns whether line smoothing is enabled.

methods.name: setSmoothLine
methods.description: Enables or disables line smoothing.

methods.name: getLabelLayout
methods.description: Returns the label layout object.

methods.name: setLabelLayout
methods.description: Sets the label layout object.

methods.name: setTrendLines
methods.description: Sets the trend lines associated with the data series.

methods.name: getTrendLines
methods.description: Returns all trend lines associated with the data series.
